//: Turborepo task graph. Caching + topological ordering keep CI fast and reproducible. No task depends on network state; all inputs are pinned. The test task declares every env var that decides whether a suite RUNS, because turbo strips undeclared ones and that once let the Postgres suites skip inside a green build. HONESTTOTAL_PG_DSN points the catalog adapter suite at an existing server instead of testcontainers; HONESTTOTAL_FEED_A/B point the catalog suites at the two provider exports, which live outside this repository and are absent in CI.
